svg.text: Scatter check: real score of 200-game groups vs the curve (illustrative)
Big k (≈1,000): dots stay inside the noise band → eval is a reliable guide
Eval after Black’s move, cp, White’s view (+ = good for White)
Small k (≈50): dots spill far outside the band → eval is a weak guide
Eval after Black’s move, cp, White’s view (+ = good for White)
Line: the curve. Shaded: coin-flip noise for 200 games (95%). Dot: one position + move group with 200 games.
